pathway.label: SSc · CD4/Tfh–B-cell–IL-21
pathway.rationale: First honest literature slice for Whole-Immune-Cell PRD MVP vertical under dual-track A. Parallel to RA Stage 1 lock; does not replace ASK question. EBV hypothesized only.

stage1ActiveScope.researchQuestion: Why do some patients with rheumatoid arthritis respond differently to anti-TNF therapy, and which biomarkers or immune mechanisms are best supported for defining those subgroups?

cellCards.label: T follicular helper (Tfh) cells
cellCards.definition: CD4 helper T-cell subset specialised for B-cell help in germinal centres; typically CXCR5⁺ PD-1⁺ BCL6⁺ and a major IL-21 source.
cellCards.notes: PRD SSc vertical subset. CL hint only — not Gate C approved ontology bind.

cellCards.label: Tfh1-skewed follicular helper cells
cellCards.definition: Tfh cells with Th1-like cytokine skew (e.g. IFN-γ-leaning) invoked as a competing subset frame in SSc B-cell dysregulation.

ontologyHints.label: T follicular helper cell (parent class hint)

cellCards.notes: No dedicated CL term for Tfh1 — parent Tfh CL used as hint. teaching=hypothesized on related edge.

cellCards.label: B cell
cellCards.definition: Adaptive lymphocyte producing antigen receptors; differentiation toward antibody-secreting cells is IL-21-responsive in the SSc Tfh–IL-21 frame.
cellCards.notes: CL hint only. CD21^low framing cites PMID 37763102 — not CDS.

cellCards.label: Plasmablast
cellCards.definition: Short-lived antibody-secreting B-lineage cell; in SSc, circulating Tfh are reported to promote plasmablast differentiation via IL-21.
cellCards.notes: Core SSc pathway object (Ricard 2019). CL hint only.

cellCards.label: IL-21
cellCards.definition: Type I cytokine produced by Tfh (and related helpers) that drives B-cell differentiation toward antibody-secreting cells.
cellCards.notes: Cytokine — CL not applicable; NCBIGene/PR hints only. Not a dosing or CDS claim.

cellCards.label: Systemic sclerosis
cellCards.definition: Systemic autoimmune disease with vasculopathy and fibrosis; PRD MVP vertical for CD4/Tfh–B–IL-21 under dual-track A (RA remains Stage 1 lock).
subsetsOrRelated: limited SSc (MONDO:0016359 hint only — not seeded)
cellCards.notes: MONDO hint only. Does not replace RA Stage 1 activeScope. partnerSigned stays false.

cellCards.label: Skin fibrosis
cellCards.definition: Fibrotic dermal phenotype in SSc; Tfh-like cells are reported to contribute (fibrosis-facing competing/complementary frame).
cellCards.notes: No MONDO/CL bind for this phenotype stub — literature PMIDs only.

cellCards.label: Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)
cellCards.definition: Hypothesized pathogen / fibroblast–TLR axis in scleroderma — separate uncertainty branch; never merged as proven Tfh→B→IL-21 causation.
cellCards.notes: teaching=hypothesized only. No CL/MONDO cell bind. Optional future taxon locator: NCBITaxon:10376 (not wired as ontologyHint type).

cellCards.label: CXCL13+ Tfh-like T cells (SSc skin)
cellCards.definition: Recirculating CXCL13+ T-cell cluster in SSc skin with Tfh-like gene programme, often adjacent to B cells — tissue complement to circulating Tfh.

ontologyHints.label: T follicular helper cell (parent class hint)

cellCards.notes: Depth deepen card. CL parent hint only — not full ontology bind.

cellCards.label: BAFF (B-cell activating factor)
cellCards.definition: TNF-family cytokine supporting B-cell survival/proliferation; elevated serum BAFF and enhanced BAFF signalling reported in SSc B lymphocytes.
cellCards.notes: Depth deepen. Not a BAFF-drug dosing or CDS claim.

claims.assertion: Circulating follicular helper T cells are increased in systemic sclerosis (dual-track PRD MVP seed — not Stage 1 partner lock; not CDS).
Tfh cells produce / drive IL-21 as a defining helper cytokine for B-cell help (foundational Tfh biology; used as SSc pathway axis context).
IL-21 induces differentiation of human naive and memory B cells into antibody-secreting plasma cells (B-help axis underpinning SSc Tfh–IL-21 framing).
In systemic sclerosis, circulating Tfh promote plasmablast differentiation through the IL-21 pathway (SSc-specific pathway seed).
T follicular helper-like cells contribute to skin fibrosis (fibrosis-facing competing / complementary frame for SSc pathway exploration).
Imbalance toward Tfh1 cells is associated with aberrant B-cell differentiation in systemic sclerosis (competing Tfh-subset explanation).
EBV infection has been hypothesized to contribute to scleroderma fibroblast / TLR pathway dysregulation — separate uncertainty branch; not a proven Tfh→B→IL-21 causal merge.
Commentary frame: T follicular helper cells are discussed as drivers of skin fibrosis (neighbourhood support for the Taylor 2018 fibrosis-facing explanation).
In systemic sclerosis, peripheral CD21low B cells and serum IL-4 / IL-21 are reported to influence joint involvement (B-cell–IL-21 neighbourhood deepen; not Stage 1 RA lock).
Single-cell analysis of SSc skin identifies a CXCL13+ Tfh-like T-cell cluster adjacent to B cells and poised to promote local B-cell responses (neighbourhood deepen; not Stage 1 RA lock).
Serum BAFF is elevated in systemic sclerosis with enhanced BAFF signalling reported in SSc B lymphocytes (B-survival neighbourhood deepen; not a therapeutic claim).
BAFF antagonism attenuates skin fibrosis in the tight-skin mouse model (hypothesized translational frame — not human dosing, not CDS, not partnerSigned).

CXCL4 is a predominant protein secreted by plasmacytoid dendritic cells in systemic sclerosis and circulating levels associate with fibrosis phenotypes (biomarker neighbourhood — not a therapeutic claim).

Therapeutic IL-6 blockade can reverse TGF-β pathway activation signatures in dermal fibroblasts in SSc clinical-trial biospecimens (faSScinate insight — hypothesized translational frame; not dosing CDS).

B-cell depletion with rituximab has been studied in diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis with exploratory clinical and skin signals (small open-label / pilot neighbourhood — hypothesized only; not approved SSc CDS).
